entry.title: Setup Showcase
entry.content:
Hardware

I am a laptop as a Desktop kind of girl. I use my laptop docked the vast majority of the time.

  • Laptop: Framework 13
    • CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 7640U 6C/12T
    • GPU: AMD Radeon 700M
    • RAM: 1x32Go 5600MT/s DDR5
    • Storage: Lexar 512Go NVMe SSD
    • Screen:
      • Size: 13.5“
      • Resolution: 2880x1920
      • Refresh Rate: 120Hz
      • Scale: 2
      • Addition; Matte anti-glare
    • Battery: 61Wh (capped at 80% for battery preservation)
    • Modules:
      • 1x USB-C 4.0 (top right)
      • 1x DP (top left)
      • 1x USB-C 3.2 (bottom left)
      • 1x USB-A 3.2 (bottom right)
  • Screen: Dell
    • Size: 27“
    • Resolution: 2560x1440
    • Refresh Rate: Up to 180Hz (capped at 120Hz for consistency)
    • Scale: 1.25
  • Input:
    • Apple MagicTrackpad USB-C
    • Keychron K4 Pro QMK
      • Switches: Brown (with one green)
  • 2FA: Two Yubikey 5C NFC

Software

Here are the different softwares I use, for more information see the git page README

  • OS: Fedora Linux Workstation 41
  • WM: Niri on Wayland
    • Almost stock configuration
  • Bar: Waybar
  • Terminal: Alacritty
    • Font: Monaspace Xenon 9pt
  • Shell: fish
    • fzf-pass: a fish function for pass
    • fzf-browse: a fish function to browse files and open them
  • Prompt: Starship
    • Modified pure prompt
  • App Launcher: Rofi
    • Colour scheme: Catppuccin Mocha
  • Lock: Hyprlock
    • With fingerprint
  • Editor: neovim
    • LazyVim
    • Mason for LSPs
    • Lots of plugins
  • Docking handler: kanshi
  • Containers: Podman
    • Language Tool Server
  • Session Manager: GDM
  • Finance: GNUCash
  • Passwords: KeepassXC & pass
  • Backups: Restic

entry.title: Hello World!
entry.content:
Intro

Welcome to my blog!

I have been running a writing blog for quite some time now but I thought it was finally time to restart my general blog!

Content

Here you will find, amongst other things.

  • Software I discovered
  • Hardware (rarer)
  • Linux configuration
  • Gay/LGBTI+ shit
  • And whatever I want to write

What you won’t find though (except for some announcements) are any news about my writing. All the writing stuff is on my writing page

Services

You can see the services I run on the uptime page.

At the moment of writing I run:

On my Hetzner server

  • A forgejo instance and runner
  • A Conduwuit matrix server (faefox.dev)
  • A Cinny matrix client instance

On CloudFare page

  • This website and blog
  • The writing website and blog
  • The calc’s website

Roadmap

My current TODO list:

  • Implementing an online reader on my writing website (see GitHub)
  • Making a website at faefox.dev
  • My novel (updates can be found on the writing blog)
